title: Run repository workflows in isolated headless executors
author: w0F5vYijNonu8kkqLSa_jYY4GIV-Q5HpbxYY525ggm4

events.title: Run repository workflows in isolated headless executors
events.body:
## Outcome

Turn the existing local workflow runner contract into a bounded headless executor that can produce signed checks for an exact commit.

## Implementation

- Define signed run requests bound to repository identity, commit, workflow digest, requested capabilities, and requester role.
- Execute in an isolated temporary workspace with CPU, memory, process, time, disk, output, and configurable network limits.
- Support local and remote executor registration through the same protocol without requiring a hosted runner.
- Stream bounded logs, redact configured secrets, handle cancellation, and sign terminal result metadata.
- Publish queued, running, passed, failed, canceled, and timed-out checks through #471.

## Acceptance criteria

- A result cannot be applied to a different commit or workflow digest.
- Host files, processes, credentials, and private network routes are inaccessible unless explicitly granted.
- Cancellation and timeout leave no process or writable workspace behind.
- Logs and artifacts remain within configured byte and retention limits.
- Local and remote fixture executors produce the same normalized check contract.

## Dependencies

Uses the repository's existing local action runner as the baseline and feeds #454 and #471.

## Verification

Run success, failure, timeout, fork bomb, memory, disk, output, cancellation, secret, network-denied, artifact, remote-disconnect, replay, and wrong-commit fixtures.
